messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":16,"text":"He who sells, let him be as he who flees away, and he who buys, as one who will lose.","verse":41},{"chapter":16,"text":"Let he who does business be as he who has no profit by it, and he who builds, as he who won’t dwell in it,","verse":42},{"chapter":16,"text":"and he who sows, as if he wouldn’t reap, so also he who prunes the vines, as he who won’t gather the grapes,","verse":43},{"chapter":16,"text":"those who marry, as those who will have no children, and those who don’t marry, as the widowed.","verse":44},{"chapter":16,"text":"Because of this, those who labor, labor in vain;","verse":45},{"chapter":16,"text":"for foreigners will reap their fruits, plunder their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captive, for in captivity and famine they will conceive their children.","verse":46},{"chapter":16,"text":"Those who conduct business, do so only to be plundered. The more they adorn their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons,","verse":47},{"chapter":16,"text":"the more I will hate them for their sins,” says the Lord.","verse":48},{"chapter":16,"text":"Just as a respectable and virtuous woman hates a prostitute,","verse":49},{"chapter":16,"text":"so will righteousness hate iniquity when she adorns herself, and will accuse her to her face when he comes who will defend him who diligently searches out every sin on earth.","verse":50},{"chapter":16,"text":"Therefore don’t be like her or her works.","verse":51},{"chapter":16,"text":"For yet a little while, and iniquity will be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness will reign over us.","verse":52},{"chapter":16,"text":"Don’t let the sinner say that he has not sinned; for God will burn coals of fire on the head of one who says “I haven’t sinned before God and his glory.”","verse":53},{"chapter":16,"text":"Behold, the Lord knows all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts.","verse":54},{"chapter":16,"text":"He said, “Let the earth be made,” and it was made, “Let the sky be made,” and it was made.","verse":55},{"chapter":16,"text":"At his word, the stars were established, and he knows the number of the stars.","verse":56},{"chapter":16,"text":"He searches the deep and its treasures. He has measured the sea and what it contains.","verse":57},{"chapter":16,"text":"He has shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word, he hung the earth over the waters.","verse":58},{"chapter":16,"text":"He has spread out the sky like a vault. He has founded it over the waters.","verse":59},{"chapter":16,"text":"He has made springs of water in the desert and pools on the tops of the mountains to send out rivers from the heights to water the earth.","verse":60}]}
